hero_summary: The Monarchy suits renters seeking a riverside Da Nang apartment complex with reported studio to three-bedroom layouts and on-site everyday facilities.
overview: The Monarchy is a high-end apartment complex at 535 Tran Hung Dao, An Hai, Da Nang, developed by Danang Housing Investment Development JSC. (NDN). The project comprises Block A and Block B, with Block B divided into B1, B2 and B3. It sits beside the Han River, in the corridor between Dragon Bridge and Tran Thi Ly Bridge. NDN reports that apartments in Block B began handover in Q3 2020. Rental-building sources report studio, one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts, although exact sizes and unit specifications should be checked apartment by apartment. The complex may suit renters who value a riverside setting and shared facilities. The main trade-off is that building-wide rental terms, current availability and some operational details are not confirmed in the research dossier.

amenities: Verified project information lists a swimming pool, gym, parking, mini mart, restaurants and cafes within the complex. A kindergarten is also listed among the project amenities. PMC identifies a park and stroll garden as part of the shared environment. These facilities indicate practical on-site options for daily routines, but the dossier does not confirm operating hours, access conditions, user fees or whether every facility is available to every tenant. Security is reported by a property portal, but no current official operating specification was found. Elevator and fire-safety systems are referenced in historical operating documentation; current inspection or compliance status should be confirmed before publishing any stronger claim.
location: The Monarchy is located at 535 Tran Hung Dao, An Hai, Da Nang, on the Han River side of the road. NDN and PMC describe the complex as positioned between Dragon Bridge and Tran Thi Ly Bridge, giving the address a clear riverside and bridge-corridor context without relying on an unverified travel time. Project material also names My Khe Beach, ABC International Kindergarten and several medical facilities, including Son Tra District Hospital, Hospital 199, and Da Nang Maternity and Children's Hospital. Distances and transport modes to these places were not verified, so they should be treated as nearby references rather than precise commute promises. Renters should check the exact building entrance, unit orientation and route conditions before signing.
renting_notes: The dossier does not establish a confirmed rental price, current availability, standard deposit, lease term, building-wide pet rule, current management fee, parking fee or utility tariff. Portal figures are asking prices only and should not be presented as executed rents. Furnishing, balcony, view, parking arrangements and move-in conditions may vary by apartment. Before viewing or signing, confirm the unit and block, usable area, furniture inventory, monthly rent and inclusions, deposit, lease duration, utility billing, pet and guest rules, parking, move-in date and temporary-residence procedure with the owner or authorised rental representative.
